lessons.title: -ing ile kısaltmak
lessons.goal: -ing participle clause'ları eşzamanlı eylem, ardışık eylem, sebep ve sonuç bildirmek için anlayabilir ve kullanabilirim.

discover.title: Bir makaleden: Kuşların göçü
discover.body:
Every autumn, millions of birds leave Europe, flying thousands of kilometres to Africa. Using the sun, the stars and the Earth's magnetic field, they are able to find their way with remarkable accuracy.

How they do this has puzzled scientists for centuries. Wanting to understand the process, a team of researchers attached small tracking devices to 200 storks in Germany. Following their journeys over three years, the team discovered that young birds often took longer and more dangerous routes, wasting valuable energy.

Being less experienced, young storks seemed to rely more on other birds than on their own sense of direction. Older birds, in contrast, flew more directly, saving time and energy.

The study suggests that migration is not purely instinctive, indicating that learning plays an important role.

questions.prompt: What did the researchers attach to the storks?
Why did young storks take longer routes?

learn.explanation:
**Participle clause**, bir cümleyi **kısaltmanın** ve yazıyı daha **yoğun ve akıcı** hale getirmenin yoludur. Akademik metinlerde çok sık görülür.

**-ing participle clause (etken anlam)**

| İşlev | Uzun hali | Participle clause |
|---|---|---|
| **Eşzamanlı eylem** | Birds leave Europe **and they fly** to Africa. | Birds leave Europe, **flying** to Africa. |
| **Ardışık eylem** | **They followed** the birds **and** discovered ... | **Following** the birds, they discovered ... |
| **Sebep** | **Because they are** less experienced, they ... | **Being** less experienced, they ... |
| **Sebep** | **As she wanted** to understand, she ... | **Wanting** to understand, she ... |
| **Sonuç** | ..., **which wastes** energy. | ..., **wasting** energy. |
| **Sonuç** | ..., **which indicates** that ... | ..., **indicating** that ... |

**Altın kural: Özne aynı olmalı!**

- ✓ ***Walking** home, **I** saw an accident.* (Yürüyen = ben)
- ✗ ~~***Walking** home, **an accident** happened.*~~ (Kaza yürümüyor! → "dangling participle")

**Olumsuz:** **not** başa gelir: ***Not knowing** what to do, she called her mother.*

**Akademik yazıda sık:** *..., **suggesting** that ... / ..., **indicating** that ... / ..., **resulting in** ... / **Using** this method, ...*

examples.en: Using a new method, the team analysed the samples in half the time.
examples.tr: Yeni bir yöntem kullanan ekip örnekleri yarı sürede analiz etti.

examples.en: Not having enough money, many students work part-time.
examples.tr: Yeterli parası olmadığı için birçok öğrenci yarı zamanlı çalışıyor.

examples.en: Prices rose by 20%, resulting in a sharp fall in sales.
examples.tr: Fiyatlar %20 arttı ve bu satışlarda keskin bir düşüşe yol açtı.

learn.turkishNote: Türkçe aslında participle clause'larla dolu bir dildir: "Eve yürürken", "Ne yapacağını bilmediği için", "Yeni bir yöntem kullanarak". İngilizcedeki -ing clause'ları Türkçedeki "-arak", "-ken", "-dığı için" eklerine çok benzer. Türkçe konuşanlar için asıl tuzak "dangling participle"dır: Türkçede özne değişse bile anlam bağlamdan çıkarılabilir, ama İngilizcede participle clause'un öznesi ana cümlenin öznesiyle aynı olmak zorundadır.

lessons.title: -ed ile kısaltmak
lessons.goal: Edilgen anlamlı -ed participle clause'ları ve kısaltılmış ilgi cümlelerini akademik metinlerde anlayıp kullanabilirim.

discover.title: Bir araştırma özetinden
discover.body:
Built in the 1460s, the Grand Bazaar in Istanbul is one of the oldest covered markets in the world. Covering more than 60 streets, it attracts hundreds of thousands of visitors every day.

This study examines how the bazaar has adapted to tourism. The data collected for this research comes from interviews with 120 shopkeepers working in the bazaar.

Asked about the main changes in the last twenty years, most shopkeepers mentioned a shift from local customers to international tourists. Many traditional craftsmen, faced with rising rents, have been forced to move out.

The results, based on both interviews and sales data, indicate that the number of shops selling souvenirs has doubled since 2000. Products made by local artisans, in contrast, now represent less than 15% of all goods sold.

questions.prompt: When was the Grand Bazaar built?
What has happened to traditional craftsmen?
options: Many have been forced to move out because of rising rents.
questions.explanation: "faced with rising rents, have been forced to move out"

learn.explanation:
**-ed (past participle) clause** → **edilgen** anlam taşır.

**1. Cümle başında (sebep / bilgi):**

| Uzun hali | Participle clause |
|---|---|
| **The bazaar was built** in the 1460s. It is ... | **Built** in the 1460s, the bazaar is ... |
| **When they were asked** about changes, they ... | **Asked** about changes, they ... |
| **Because they were faced** with high rents, they ... | **Faced** with high rents, they ... |

**2. Kısaltılmış ilgi cümlesi (reduced relative clause):**

Akademik metinlerin en karakteristik yapısı:

| Uzun hali | Kısaltılmış |
|---|---|
| the data **which was collected** | the data **collected** |
| shopkeepers **who work** in the bazaar | shopkeepers **working** in the bazaar |
| products **that are made** by artisans | products **made** by artisans |
| a study **which was published** in 2020 | a study **published** in 2020 |
| the results, **which are based** on interviews | the results, **based** on interviews |

**Kural:** 

- **Etken** ilgi cümlesi → **-ing**: *people **who live** here → people **living** here*
- **Edilgen** ilgi cümlesi → **-ed / V3**: *goods **which are sold** → goods **sold***

**Dikkat:** *The man **sitting** next to me* (oturan) ≠ *The man **seated** next to me* (oturtulan, resmî)

learn.turkishNote: Türkçede "1453'te kurulan Kapalıçarşı" ya da "toplanan veriler" gibi yapılar ismin önüne gelir; İngilizcede ise participle genellikle ismin arkasına gelir: "the data collected", "the Grand Bazaar, founded in 1453". Türkçe konuşanlar akademik yazıda bu kısaltmaları kullanmayı unutup her seferinde "which was" yazarlar; bu metni uzatır. Etken (-ing) ile edilgen (-ed) arasında doğru seçim yapmak için Türkçedeki "-an" (yaşayan) ile "-ılan" (toplanan) farkını düşünün.

task.prompt: Şehrinizdeki ya da ülkenizdeki tarihi bir yeri, bir binayı ya da bir ürünü rehber gibi tanıtın. En az 3 cümle başı -ed clause (Built in ..., Known as ..., Designed by ...) ve en az 3 kısaltılmış ilgi cümlesi (people living ..., products made ..., visitors coming ...) kullanın.
task.modelAnswer: Built in the sixth century, Hagia Sophia is one of the most famous buildings in the world. Designed by two Greek scientists, it was the largest church on Earth for nearly a thousand years. Converted into a mosque in 1453, it later became a museum and is now a mosque again. Visitors coming from all over the world admire its enormous dome. The mosaics discovered under the plaster are among the finest examples of Byzantine art. Known for its incredible size and light, it continues to inspire architects working today.

lessons.title: Yaptıktan sonra
lessons.goal: Having + V3 ile önceki eylemi belirtebilir ve after / before / while / when + -ing yapılarını akademik dilde kullanabilirim.

discover.title: Yöntem bölümü (Methodology)
discover.body:
Having reviewed the existing literature, we designed a questionnaire consisting of 25 questions.

Before distributing the questionnaire, we tested it with a small group of 20 students. Having been told that some questions were unclear, we rewrote them in simpler language.

The final questionnaire was sent to 800 students. After receiving the responses, we removed incomplete answers, leaving a final sample of 612 participants.

While analysing the data, we noticed an unexpected pattern: students who worked part-time reported higher levels of satisfaction. Having identified this pattern, we conducted ten follow-up interviews to explore it further.

When interpreting these results, it is important to remember that the sample came from a single university.

questions.prompt: What did the researchers do before sending the questionnaire?
questions.explanation: "we tested it with a small group of 20 students"
"students who worked part-time reported higher levels of satisfaction"

learn.explanation:
**Perfect participle: Having + V3**

Bir eylemin **diğerinden önce tamamlandığını** vurgular.

| Uzun hali | Participle clause |
|---|---|
| **After we had reviewed** the literature, we ... | **Having reviewed** the literature, we ... |
| **Because she had lived** abroad, she ... | **Having lived** abroad, she ... |

**Edilgen: Having been + V3**

- ***Having been told** that the questions were unclear, we rewrote them.* (Bize söylendikten sonra)

**Olumsuz:** ***Not having seen** the film, I can't comment.*

**Bağlaç + -ing**

Anlamı netleştirmek için participle'ın önüne bağlaç eklenebilir:

| Bağlaç | Örnek |
|---|---|
| **after** + -ing | **After receiving** the responses, we ... |
| **before** + -ing | **Before distributing** it, we tested it. |
| **while** + -ing | **While analysing** the data, we noticed ... |
| **when** + -ing | **When interpreting** the results, ... |
| **since** + -ing | **Since moving** to Ankara, she has ... |
| **by** + -ing (yöntem) | **By comparing** the two groups, we ... |
| **on** + -ing (hemen sonra, resmî) | **On arriving**, they were taken to ... |

**After + -ing / Having + V3:** Anlam aynı, ama **After** + -ing daha sade, **Having** daha resmî ve vurgulu.

**Akademik "Methodology" bölümlerinde** bu yapılar çok sık kullanılır, çünkü işlemleri **sırayla** ve **kısa** bir şekilde anlatırlar.

examples.en: Having completed the survey, participants were given a small gift.
examples.tr: Anketi tamamlayan katılımcılara küçük bir hediye verildi.

examples.en: While working on the project, she discovered an error.
examples.tr: Proje üzerinde çalışırken bir hata keşfetti.

examples.en: By comparing the two groups, we were able to measure the effect.

learn.turkishNote: Türkçedeki "-dıktan sonra" (yaptıktan sonra) İngilizcede "Having done" ya da "After doing" ile karşılanır. Türkçe konuşanların sık yaptığı hata, "After to finish" ya da "Before to start" demektir; bağlaçlardan sonra her zaman -ing gelir. Ayrıca Türkçedeki "-arak" (karşılaştırarak) yapısı yöntem bildirdiğinde İngilizcede "By comparing" olur.

After finishing the report, she left.

task.prompt: Yaptığınız bir projeyi, bir araştırmayı ya da bir yemek tarifini adım adım bir "yöntem" bölümü gibi anlatın. Having + V3, Having been + V3, before / after / while / by + -ing yapılarından en az 6'sını kullanın.
task.modelAnswer: First, having chosen a topic, I read about ten articles on social media and sleep. Having done that, I designed a short online survey. Before sending it out, I asked three friends to test it. Having been told that it was too long, I removed five questions. After receiving 150 responses, I put all the data into a spreadsheet. While analysing it, I noticed that students who used their phones in bed slept less. By comparing different age groups, I found that the effect was strongest among first-year students.

lessons.title: Akademik kelimeler
lessons.goal: Akademik Kelime Listesi'ndeki (AWL) sık kelimeleri ve kelime ailelerini tanıyabilir, günlük kelimeleri akademik karşılıklarıyla değiştirebilirim.

discover.title: İki versiyon: aynı bulgu
discover.body:
Everyday version:
"We looked at information from 2,000 people. It shows that people who walk a lot are less likely to get depressed. This is a big difference. But maybe other things, like money or friends, also make a difference."

Academic version:
"Data from 2,000 participants were analysed. The findings indicate that regular walking is associated with a significantly lower risk of depression. However, other factors, such as income and social support, may also have influenced the results. Further research is required to establish a causal relationship."

options: Regular walking is associated with lower risk of depression.
questions.explanation: "regular walking is associated with a significantly lower risk of depression"

learn.explanation:
**Akademik Kelime Listesi (Academic Word List, AWL):** Akademik metinlerde en sık geçen yaklaşık 570 kelime ailesi. Bu kelimeleri bilmek akademik okumayı çok kolaylaştırır.

**Günlük → Akademik:**

| Günlük | Akademik |
|---|---|
| look at | **analyse / examine / investigate** |
| show | **indicate / demonstrate / illustrate** |
| big | **significant / substantial / considerable** |
| things | **factors / aspects / elements** |
| find out | **establish / determine / identify** |
| need | **require** |
| think about | **consider** |
| idea | **concept / notion** |
| way | **approach / method** |
| get | **obtain / acquire** |
| about | **approximately** (rakamlar) |
| enough | **sufficient / adequate** |

**Kelime aileleri (word families):** Bir kelimeyi öğrenince ailesini de öğrenin.

| Fiil | İsim | Sıfat | Zarf |
|---|---|---|---|
| analyse | analysis | analytical | analytically |
| signify | significance | significant | significantly |
| interpret | interpretation | interpretive | |
| vary | variation / variable | various / variable | |
| establish | establishment | established | |
| consist | consistency | consistent | consistently |

**Collocations:** *conduct research*, *carry out a study*, *collect / gather data*, *draw a conclusion*, *raise a question*, *play a role*, *have an impact on*

examples.en: The study examines the impact of social media on teenagers.
examples.tr: Çalışma sosyal medyanın gençler üzerindeki etkisini inceliyor.

examples.en: There was a significant variation between the two groups.
examples.tr: İki grup arasında anlamlı bir farklılık vardı.

examples.en: Further research is required to draw firm conclusions.
examples.tr: Kesin sonuçlar çıkarmak için daha fazla araştırma gerekiyor.

learn.turkishNote: Türkçe akademik dilde de "incelemek", "belirlemek", "anlamlı" gibi günlük dilden farklı kelimeler kullanılır. İngilizce akademik kelimelerin çoğu Latince kökenlidir ve bazıları Türkçeye de geçmiştir (analiz, faktör, konsept, hipotez, metod). Bu sizin için bir avantajdır! Ancak "significant" kelimesine dikkat: Akademik dilde genellikle "istatistiksel olarak anlamlı" demektir, sadece "önemli" değil.

task.prompt: Aşağıdaki günlük cümleleri akademik bir sunumda söyler gibi yeniden ifade edin ve her birinin ardından bir cümle daha ekleyin: (1) We looked at what 500 students said. (2) It shows that big classes are bad for learning. (3) But other things might also be important. (4) We need to do more research to find out for sure.
task.modelAnswer: One: We analysed responses from approximately 500 students. The data were collected through an online questionnaire. Two: The findings indicate that large class sizes have a significant negative impact on learning outcomes. Students in classes of more than forty reported lower levels of engagement. Three: However, other factors, such as teaching methods and student motivation, may also play a role. Four: Further research is required to establish a causal relationship. A longitudinal study would be particularly useful.

lessons.title: Okumak ve özetlemek
lessons.goal: Akademik bir metni skim ve scan stratejileriyle çözümleyebilir, ana argümanı bulabilir ve kendi cümlelerimle (paraphrase) bir özet yazabilirim.

discover.title: Akademik makale özeti: Çok dillilik ve beyin
discover.body:
Over the past two decades, a growing body of research has examined the cognitive effects of speaking more than one language. Early studies, conducted mainly with children, suggested that bilingual individuals perform better on tasks requiring attention and task-switching. This so-called "bilingual advantage" received considerable attention from the media.

More recent research, however, has challenged these findings. Having reviewed over 150 studies, several researchers concluded that the advantage is smaller than previously thought and, in some cases, may not exist at all. They argue that many early studies used small samples and failed to control for important variables, such as socio-economic background.

Nevertheless, there is consistent evidence in one area. Studies of older adults indicate that lifelong bilingualism may delay the onset of dementia by several years. Although the exact mechanism remains unclear, researchers believe that regularly switching between languages may help to build "cognitive reserve", allowing the brain to cope better with damage.

In conclusion, while the benefits of bilingualism for everyday thinking may have been exaggerated, its long-term effects on brain health appear to be significant.

options: Bilingual people perform better on attention tasks.
questions.explanation: "bilingual individuals perform better on tasks requiring attention"
"lifelong bilingualism may delay the onset of dementia"

learn.explanation:
**Akademik okuma stratejileri:**

| Strateji | Ne zaman? | Nasıl? |
|---|---|---|
| **Skimming** | Ana fikri anlamak | Başlık, ilk ve son paragraf, her paragrafın **ilk cümlesi** |
| **Scanning** | Belirli bir bilgi bulmak | Rakam, isim, tarih, anahtar kelime için hızlıca tarayın |
| **Signal words** | Argümanın yönünü anlamak | *However, Nevertheless* (karşıt görüş), *In conclusion* (sonuç) |
| **Hedging'i fark etmek** | Yazarın ne kadar emin olduğunu anlamak | *may, suggest, appear, likely* |

**Özet (summary) yazmak:**

1. **Metni okuyun** ve ana argümanı **tek cümleyle** söyleyin.
2. **Ana noktaları** not alın (örnekleri, rakamları ve ayrıntıları atın).
3. **Metne bakmadan** kendi cümlelerinizle yazın.
4. Orijinalle **karşılaştırın**: Anlam doğru mu? Kelimeler sizin mi?

**Paraphrase teknikleri:**

| Teknik | Orijinal | Paraphrase |
|---|---|---|
| **Eşanlamlı** | has **challenged** these findings | has **questioned** these results |
| **Kelime türü değiştirme** | bilingualism may **delay** dementia | bilingualism may lead to a **delay** in dementia |
| **Etken ↔ edilgen** | Researchers **reviewed** 150 studies. | 150 studies **were reviewed**. |
| **Cümle yapısını değiştirme** | Although the mechanism is unclear, ... | The mechanism is unclear; however, ... |

**Özet dili:** *The article / author argues that ... / According to the text, ... / The writer concludes that ...*

**Dikkat:** Özete **kendi görüşünüzü** eklemeyin!

examples.en: The author argues that the bilingual advantage has been exaggerated.
examples.tr: Yazar iki dilliliğin avantajının abartıldığını savunuyor.

examples.en: According to recent research, the effect is smaller than previously thought.
examples.tr: Son araştırmalara göre etki daha önce düşünülenden küçük.

examples.en: The text concludes that bilingualism may protect the brain in old age.
examples.tr: Metin iki dilliliğin yaşlılıkta beyni koruyabileceği sonucuna varıyor.

learn.turkishNote: Türk öğrenciler özet yazarken genellikle orijinal metinden cümleleri olduğu gibi kopyalar ya da sadece birkaç kelimeyi değiştirir. İngilizce akademik dünyada bu "plagiarism" (intihal) olarak kabul edilebilir. İyi bir paraphrase hem kelimeleri hem de cümle yapısını değiştirir, ama anlamı korur. En etkili yöntem: Metni okuyun, kapatın, sonra kendi cümlelerinizle yazın.

task.prompt: Yukarıdaki "Çok dillilik ve beyin" metninin özetini yazın (100–130 kelime). Metne bakmadan, kendi cümlelerinizle yazın. Ana argümanı ilk cümlede verin, iki ana noktayı (abartılmış günlük avantaj, beyin sağlığına uzun vadeli etki) açıklayın ve yazarın sonucunu aktarın. Özet dili (The text argues / According to / concludes), en az 3 AWL kelimesi ve en az bir participle clause kullanın. Kendi görüşünüzü eklemeyin.
task.modelAnswer: The article examines research on how speaking two or more languages affects the brain. According to early studies, bilingual people were thought to be better at tasks involving concentration and switching between activities. However, having analysed a large number of later studies, some researchers have questioned this claim, arguing that the effect is either very small or non-existent. They point out that many of the original studies were based on limited samples and did not consider other relevant factors, such as family income. In contrast, there is more reliable evidence that using two languages throughout life may postpone the symptoms of dementia in old age. The text concludes that, although the everyday benefits may have been overstated, the long-term impact on brain health seems considerable.

questions.prompt: Aşağıdaki kısa metni okuyun ve 80–100 kelimelik bir özet yazın: "Many cities around the world have introduced congestion charges, requiring drivers to pay a fee to enter the city centre during busy hours. Supporters argue that such schemes reduce traffic and air pollution while generating money for public transport. Evidence from several European cities indicates that traffic in charged zones fell by between 15 and 30 percent in the first year. Critics, however, claim that the charges unfairly affect lower-income drivers, who may have no alternative to using a car. They also point out that some of the initial reductions in traffic have become smaller over time. Overall, the research suggests that congestion charges can be effective, provided that they are combined with affordable and reliable public transport." Kendi cümlelerinizle, özet dili, AWL kelimeleri ve en az bir participle clause kullanın.
questions.modelAnswer: The text discusses congestion charges, which oblige drivers to pay a fee for entering city centres at peak times. According to supporters, these schemes decrease traffic and pollution while providing funding for public transport. Data from a number of European cities demonstrate a substantial fall in traffic during the first year. Opponents, however, argue that the fees place an unfair burden on poorer drivers lacking other transport options, and they note that the early benefits have declined over time. The text concludes that, when supported by cheap and efficient public transport, congestion charges can be a successful approach.
